title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Please know I loved the Campos story. It was a great piece of writing. I got confused around the section when you talk about the cuban national team (in part because I’m confused what the age-range is) but also because the story calls him “Castro” at one point.
I figure you could have an editor fix that one real quick. Just wanted to point it out before some twitter user did

Near the bottom of the second section
